description: This file defines a class `DatabasePasswordEncryptor` responsible for encrypting and decrypting passwords using AES encryption, as well as generating and verifying bcrypt password hashes. It also contains a main method for command-line password encryption.

classes.name: DatabasePasswordEncryptor
classes.description: A service class that provides password encryption, decryption, and hash validation functionalities, utilizing AES encryption and bcrypt hashing. It also includes a command-line utility for password encryption.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a plaintext password using the master password and encryption configuration from properties.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted password back to plaintext using the master password and encryption configuration from properties.

methods.name: getMasterPasswordHash
methods.description: Returns a bcrypt hash of the master password, which is retrieved from the project properties.

methods.name: isMasterPasswordHashValid
methods.description: Checks if a given bcrypt hash matches the current master password.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Command-line utility to encrypt a password with a provided master password and output the encrypted password and its hash.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Generates a bcrypt hash for a given master password.
